title: NVIDIA begins shipping Vera CPUs built around agent workloads
friendlyTitle: NVIDIA starts shipping a CPU made for AI agents
summary: NVIDIA says its first custom CPU, Vera, is now shipping to cloud providers and major AI labs, with AWS receiving an initial server and Vera Rubin GPU. The company positions Vera’s 88 cores and high memory bandwidth for agent sandboxes, tool calls, retrieval and orchestration workloads that accompany GPU inference.
friendlySummary: NVIDIA’s new Vera CPU is designed for the computer work around AI models, such as running tools, finding files and managing many tasks. Early systems are going to cloud companies and AI labs.
whyItMatters: Agent performance increasingly depends on CPUs and memory systems around the model, not just accelerators. Wider cloud deployment could eventually improve response time and economics for tool-heavy enterprise agents, though NVIDIA’s performance figures are vendor claims.
friendlyWhyItMatters: Better supporting hardware could make AI agents faster and cheaper, but real customer results still need to be measured.
